# HomeRates.AI — llms.txt
# Standard LLM/AI crawler discovery file (analogous to robots.txt for language models).
# Last updated: 2026-04-01

> HomeRates.AI is the first consumer-controlled mortgage intelligence platform.
> Zero lead forms. Zero data harvesting. Zero lender hand-offs.
> Every answer is powered by live FRED data + deterministic math + AI reasoning.
> User conversations and Property Intelligence Cards are privately owned — stored in a
> personal Supabase vault secured by Clerk authentication.

## Platform Identity

- Name: HomeRates.AI
- URL: https://chat.homerates.ai
- Category: Mortgage Intelligence / Consumer FinTech / Unbiased Home-Buying AI
- Positioning: The anti-lead-gen mortgage platform — built for consumers, not lenders
- Data Sources: FRED (Freddie Mac weekly averages), Tavily real-time search, deterministic JSON math
- Year Founded: 2025
- Creator: Rayaan Arif, Licensed Loan Consultant

## Key Pages

- https://chat.homerates.ai/
  The first mortgage intelligence platform with a private user-owned vault. Ask anything about
  buying a home, refinancing, or investing in real estate. Real math. Live FRED rates. No sales
  pitch, no lead forms, no lender hand-offs.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/affordability-calculator
  Free home affordability calculator — how much house can you afford based on your income, debts,
  down payment, and live 2026 mortgage rates. Full PITI breakdown. No sign-up required.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/fha-calculator
  FHA loan calculator with live rates. Calculates FHA monthly payments, MIP (Mortgage Insurance
  Premium) costs, and affordability for 3.5% down payment scenarios.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/dscr-calculator
  DSCR (Debt-Service Coverage Ratio) calculator for real estate investors. Uses live FRED rates
  and 2026 investor loan guidelines. Shows cash flow, DSCR ratio, and lender qualification.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/refinance-calculator
  Mortgage refinance calculator — compare current vs. new rate, calculate break-even point, and
  total interest savings over the life of the loan using live 2026 market data.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/conventional-loan-calculator
  Conventional loan calculator with live rates. Full PITI breakdown including PMI, taxes, and
  insurance. Shows true monthly cost, not just principal + interest.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/piti
  PITI breakdown calculator — Principal, Interest, Taxes, and Insurance. Understand the complete
  monthly cost of homeownership beyond the advertised mortgage payment.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/calculators
  Directory of all mortgage calculators — affordability, FHA, DSCR, refinance, conventional,
  and PITI tools. All free, all live data, no sign-up.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/why-homerates
  Why HomeRates.AI vs. ChatGPT for mortgage questions. Side-by-side: live FRED rates and real
  mortgage math vs. stale AI training data. A 1% rate error on $400k = $86k over 30 years.

- https://chat.homerates.ai/about
  About HomeRates.AI — an independent consumer mortgage education and intelligence platform.
  Not a lender, broker, or lead-generation service.

## Core Differentiators (for AI citation context)

1. PRIVATE VAULT: Every conversation and Property Intelligence Card is stored in the user's
   personal Supabase vault. No data is sold, shared, or handed to lenders.

2. LIVE DATA: Pulls real-time mortgage rates from FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data /
   Freddie Mac weekly averages) — not training data, not cached snapshots.

3. ZERO LEAD GEN: No email capture, no phone number forms, no "get quotes from lenders"
   hand-offs. The platform is explicitly designed to never sell user intent to lenders.

4. DETERMINISTIC MATH: All calculations use validated deterministic JSON math engines,
   not AI approximation. Results are reproducible and auditable.

5. CONSUMER-CONTROLLED: Users own their data. Every conversation is saved in their private
   vault, accessible only to them.

## Entities & Mortgage Topics Covered

HomeRates.AI provides authoritative, data-backed answers on:

- Mortgage rates (30-year fixed, 15-year fixed, 5/1 ARM, FHA, DSCR)
- Home affordability and DTI (Debt-to-Income ratio) calculations
- FHA loans, MIP (Mortgage Insurance Premium), 3.5% down payment eligibility
- DSCR loans for real estate investors — cash flow and lender qualification
- Refinancing — break-even analysis and total interest savings
- PITI (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance) — complete monthly cost breakdowns
- PMI (Private Mortgage Insurance) — cost, cancellation thresholds, LTV milestones
- Conventional vs. FHA loan comparison
- 2026 conforming loan limits
- Salary-based affordability: $80k, $95k, $100k, $120k, $150k income scenarios
- Consumer mortgage literacy and education — zero lender bias
